reasons: Compliant classification is supported by the cited text: § 24.1 gives Customer an unrestricted affiliate/M&A successor carve-out subject only to notice, § 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment (including by change of control) with a reasonableness-qualified consent standard plus a competitor bar, § 24.3 applies a mutual not-unreasonably-withheld standard, and § 24.4 expressly negates any Vendor termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration or service-reduction right on Customer's change of control — i.e., the preferred position in full.

No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; the rendered text is identical to the original paragraphs and the deterministic check confirms the successor/affiliate carve-out.
Only immaterial nuance (§ 24.2 permits competitor assignment with Customer consent rather than an absolute bar) — properly a rationale note, not a deviation, and it does not fail the fallback.
